scope: All 79 daljn- adjective forms plus eight adjacent malformed Dalja/daljem/dalju forms in live v019 Latin sources.
choice: Use the official comparative daljši paradigm for every audited further/additional/subsequent meaning, preserving capitalization, case, gender, and number. Preserve all 212 correct adverbial dalje forms and all ten already-canonical daljš- forms.
motivation: Every German-aligned occurrence means further, additional, subsequent, continued, or in the following; none denotes physical or geographic remoteness. The official dictionary explicitly distinguishes daljnji/daljny 'remote' from daljši 'further/farther/subsequent', including the model v daljšem.
alternatives_rejected: Retain daljn- as a stylistic variant: the official semantic split makes it the wrong adjective in all 79 contexts.
Replace every instance with slědujući: many sites mean additional or further rather than chronologically following.
Normalize the adverb dalje too: its 212 uses are already official and semantically distinct.
Let Croatian/Slovenian token volume control the bridge: independent-language evidence is weighted by family, and the official semantic distinction remains authoritative.

official_dictionary.accepted_entry: id 3032 daljši, type 1, further/farther/subsequent; model v daljšem
